title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WS Form WS Form…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WS Form LITE versions up to 1.12.19. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing malicious scripts to be stored and executed in the context of users viewing the affected pages.
